column1: # Deliberate differences from Yomitan d3c54c1 (docs/languages.md 8.2). Yomitan has no Chinese transforms; its one Chinese processor is normalizeRadicalCharacters.

column7: The pack also maps the 112 CJK Radicals Supplement characters that Unicode's EquivalentUnifiedIdeograph.txt (17.0) gives an ideograph, such as ⻔ → 门 and ⻓ → 长, which text copied from PDFs contains. They have no compatibility decomposition, so Yomitan's NFKD leaves them as they are. On the 216 radicals that NFKD changes, both give the same ideograph.
